Variable personalities: partnerships (0.5), identifiers, per-seat personas in Gen 8 and 8X

Max, 21:14 UTC on 14 November: randomize Sid's personalities; partners
correlated 0.5; SidVariable as an identifier that readers use by default;
partners can be asked for estimated styles; the variability and disclosure
rules public; Gen 8/9 to take the capability.

- persona.py: draw_partnership (each latent draw correlated 0.5 with the
  partner's; dimension correlation drawn per partnership), seats(),
  public(identifier), KNOWN (SidVariable, Gen8Variable), is_variable,
  describe(persona, 'opponent' | 'partner' | 'full').
- Gen7Player / X8Player: table_styles {seat: {play, near}} set per table; a
  Gen 8 seat styles among its near_tie cards, an 8X seat among rollout
  candidates within its own margin (random share: one of them at random).
  Seats without a persona play as before (tests).
- X8Player.meet: a blind bot is still told a variable population's
  identifier (x8 read_variable, default on).
- gen8_match: bots with "persona": {"variable": true} get a partnership a
  side per board, play styles via table_styles, bidding via VariableBidder;
  records keep the personas.
- make_bots.py / loop-bots.json: SidVariable (stu4c-put + persona) and
  Gen8Variable (8p-32-v41 at margin 0 + persona); no existing bot changed.

Max, 21:14 UTC on 14 Nov: "Update Sid to randomize personalities", partners
correlated 0.5, SidVariable as the identifier other bots use, partners can
be asked for estimated styles, the variability and disclosure public.

- personas.py: each board North gets a persona, East-West a partnership
  (bridge_harness/persona.py at the bundle source); what the person may
  know (partner's knowledge view, opponents' disclosure), the actual styles
  after the board, the public rules.
- engine.py: bid/play take the seat's style per call (stateless); the Sids
  meet each other as SidVariable and treat it as keeping guaranteed
  contracts; Sid's own table plays the same N/E/W personas, South plain.
- tables/store/app/page: personas per board (stored, kept for a deal played
  again), a styles panel during and after the board and on the review page.
- Recipe: source moves to 109a21c (a42fe6c's engine plus the persona code).
- tests/test_personas.py (needs SIDPLAY_TEST_SOURCE with persona.py).
